Our Story

Kitsia began as a feeling before it became a brand.

The feeling of wanting to give someone something beautiful — not for an occasion, not because it was expected — but simply because beautiful things deserve to be worn, loved and held.

Every piece is grown, cut and set with the same care: lab diamonds and 18k gold, made for a body and the space between stone and skin.

“We speak the language of love through jewellery.”

The Kitsia Moment

For the moments that matter.

Receiving Kitsia should feel like the gift itself. Each piece arrives in signature packaging — a considered, gift-worthy unboxing designed to be remembered as clearly as the jewellery inside.

Why Lab Diamonds

The same brilliance. A brighter choice.

Identical

Optically and chemically the same as mined diamonds — to the eye and the lab.

Better value

A larger, finer stone for what you would spend on a smaller mined one.

Kinder origin

Grown, not extracted — a cleaner story behind every piece.

Certified

Every stone independently graded and documented.
